handoff.salientSummary: Foundation milestone scrutiny: validators pass (test/typecheck/lint), 5/7 features reviewed pass, 2 features fail with blocking issues (state-management and feature-ordering missing required tests). Synthesis: .factory/validation/foundation/scrutiny/synthesis.json
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Completed scrutiny validation for foundation milestone. Ran all validators (bun test, bun run check, bun run lint) - all passed with 61 tests. Spawned 7 review subagents in parallel to examine each completed foundation feature. Each reviewer examined git diffs, code quality, test coverage, and adherence to feature descriptions. Synthesized findings into a comprehensive report with blocking issues, non-blocking issues, applied updates (library/conventions.md), and recommended guidance updates for the orchestrator.
